chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
Biret, Rimmantas, Arnulf Sigurdarson, Máret, Mieppi, Áilu, Vaigirdė, Ingmund Sigurdarson, Rimgirdė and MaelSechnaill arrived together in summer.

The founding party had two adult sows and one adult boar and 1 longship.

Biret, Arnulf Sigurdarson and Ingmund Sigurdarson worked as farmers. Rimmantas, Máret, Áilu, Vaigirdė and MaelSechnaill worked as fishers. Mieppi worked as a woodworker. Rimgirdė worked as a hunter.

Mieppi and Rimgirdė were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.
